items.stem: Which of the following statements is true about the images that look similar?
In the given scenario, Nitin and Hari built walls of different lengths using different amounts of cement. What conclusion can we draw from their ratios?
In a digital image, the width and height are in the ratio 3 : 2. If the width of the image is increased by 20%, what should be the percentage increase in the height to maintain the same proportion?
Which of the following is the correct way to express that two ratios are proportional?

A photographer wants to resize a photo such that its width and height are in the same proportion as the original. If the original width is 60 mm and the original height is 40 mm, and the new width is 90 mm, what should be the new height?
In Example 8, if the ratio of students to rice is 120 : 15, what is the factor of change in the number of students?
If Manjunath mixes 20 mL of coffee decoction with 30 mL of milk, what is the ratio of coffee decoction to milk?
If the ratio of students to rice in Example 8 is 120 : 15, and on a rainy day only 80 students come, how much rice should the cook make?
If a:b::c:d, which of the following is true?
A small farmer in Himachal Pradesh sells each 200 g packet of tea for ₹200. A large estate in Meghalaya sells each 1 kg packet of tea for ₹800. Are the weight-to-price ratios proportional?
Puneeth’s father went from Lucknow to Kanpur in 2 hours by riding his motorcycle at a speed of 50 km/h. If he drives at 75 km/h, how long will it take him to reach Kanpur?
A mixture of 40 kg contains sand and cement in the ratio 3 : 1. How much cement should be added to make the ratio 5 : 2?
What is the ratio of grey bricks to coloured bricks in a block of the pattern shown in the passage?
What is the ratio of copper to nickel in a ₹10 coin?
A farmer needs to apply 10 tonnes of cow manure for 1 acre of land. If his plot is 200 ft by 500 ft, how much manure should he buy?
What is the simplest form of the ratio 9 : 6?
A mason requires 1450 bricks to build a 10-foot wall. How many bricks are needed to build a wall of 108 feet?
The Earth travels 940 million kilometres in a year. How many kilometres will it travel in a week?
If 1 litre of water has a mass of 1 kg, what is the mass of 1 litre of gold if the mass of equal volumes of gold and water are in the ratio 37:2?
If the cost of 10 tonnes of cow manure is required for 1 acre of land, and a farmer has a plot of land measuring 200 ft by 500 ft, how much manure should he buy? (Note: 1 acre = 43,560 sq. ft.)
A tap takes 15 seconds to fill a mug of water with a volume of 500 mL. How much time does the same tap take to fill a bucket of water with a 10-litre capacity?
If 12 counters are divided between two people in the ratio 3 : 1, how many counters does the person with the smaller share get?
If 42 counters are divided between two people in the ratio 4 : 3, what is the size of each group?

A tractor can plough the same area of a field 4 times faster than a pair of oxen. A pair of oxen takes 6 hours to plough an acre of land. How much time would it take if the farmer used a tractor instead?
A mixture of 40 kg contains sand and cement in the ratio of 3 : 1. How much cement should be added to make the ratio of sand to cement 5 : 2?
In Example 7, if the ratio 14 : 21 is proportional to 2 : 3, what is the missing number in the ratio 6 : ______?
If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle, dividing the other two sides in the same ratio, which theorem is this an example of?
A car travels 90 km in 150 minutes. If it continues at the same speed, what distance will it cover in 4 hours?
If 12 counters are shared between two people in the ratio 3 : 1, how many counters does each person get?
In a science lab, acid and water are mixed in the ratio 1 : 5. If a solution has 240 mL, how much acid is in it?
What is the ratio of orange juice to apple juice if Anagh mixes 600 mL of orange juice with 900 mL of apple juice?
If a line is drawn parallel to one side of a triangle, what can be said about the other two sides?
If the ratio of neck to the rest of the body in a crane is 4 : 6, and a person's height is 150 cm, what is the height of the person's neck?
What is the ratio of orange juice to apple juice if Anagh mixes 600 mL of orange juice with 900 mL of apple juice?
What is the ratio of teachers to students in the school described in Example 4?
In Example 6, what is the ratio of Neelima's age to her mother's age when Neelima is 12 years old?
If the ratio of the width to height of a rectangle is 60 : 40, what is the simplest form of this ratio?
Prashanti and Bhuvan invested ₹75,000 and ₹25,000 respectively. If they gained a profit of ₹4,000, how much profit does Prashanti get?
